summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all task requirements. Parses and aggregates test result formats (JSON, JUnit XML) with 11 edge cases (malformed inputs, entity encoding, CDATA, status aliases, duration edge cases). Aggregation tests verify flaky detection, sorting, totals, and verdicts across matrix scenarios. CLI tests cover argument parsing, file discovery, subprocess invocation, exit codes (0/1/2), and GitHub Actions integration (GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, GITHUB_OUTPUT). Markdown tests assert exact output strings for CI assertions. Workflow tests statically validate YAML structure, permissions, triggers, job dependencies, script references, and actionlint compliance. Integration tests via act-harness run real Docker scenarios with multiple matrix cases (mixed-matrix, all-green) and assert exact aggregate numbers. Tests are well-organized by concern, use clear helper functions to reduce boilerplate, maintain independence, and include proper cleanup. Fixture management is dynamic per-test. Use of conditional act-harness execution (RUN_ACT=1 guard) prevents Docker overhead during normal testing while enabling comprehensive integration validation on demand. Would confidently catch regressions across all dimensions.
